topic: The side character fans loved more than the hero — who got their own series
hook: Fans loved the side character more. She got her own series.
script: Fans loved the side character more. She got her own series. Mikasa from Attack on Titan was written as a supporting character. Fan polls in Japan consistently ranked her above the main protagonist Eren. She became the character on all merchandise. The final arc was rewritten to give her a more central role. In 2024 a prequel manga focusing solely on Mikasa's backstory was announced. The audience chose the story. Follow for side characters who outgrew the stories they were born into.
